painpoints.text: Evidence capture (run 01M23RQRCB748R4VRXA2WE6BZ0, seed fabro-e702) mis-attributed seed work: it listed lib/components/fabro-workflow/src/pipeline/pull_request.rs +58/-3 as seed work with an EMPTY diff body, while the actual seed work (implementer.md +2/-0) was filed under loop churn with no loop-work diff shown. Git shows pull_request.rs was last touched by ae95484 (the FAILED implementer commit, parent of claim base b8e20c9) — the capture appears to have diffed against a base that predates the claim base, resurrecting the failed attempt's hunks. For a churn-only prompt seed the loop-work diff section is the review scope, so the capture delivered neither scope correctly. Fix: the evidence script's per-seed claim-base resolution should exclude failed-attempt commits (or diff against the last succeeded commit's parent), and a listed seed-work file with an empty diff body should be a hard error in the capture itself.

observations: Verified the spec directly with git rather than trusting the capture: git diff b8e20c9..HEAD shows exactly implementer.md +2 (the two mandated rules at lines 29 and 31, both citing run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 inline) plus journal lines; no other prompts, no workflow.toml, auto_merge untouched, worktree clean.
Rule (a) correctly extends the existing 600000 cargo-build tier as a 'timeout family' (line 31 references the line-30 rule) rather than duplicating it, matching the seed's integration requirement.

The tester gate reported 'touched crates: fabro-workflow' despite no lib/ files changing this seed — likely the same stale-base attribution feeding the gate's touched-crate detection; harmless here (gate ran green either way) but the same root cause as the painpoint.
